description_original: Olympus OM-D E-M10 Mirrorless Camera with 14–42mm Lens: Take the portable Olympus OM-D E-M10 on the go to ensure you're ready to capture important moments as they come up. An included M.Zuiko digital II R lens allows you to start shooting right away and can be swapped out for other lenses (sold separately) if you'd prefer. To share photos and HD videos with your friends and relatives, simply connect your wireless devices using the camera's built-in Wi-Fi. Memory card sold separately.
